Coral Hand Lamp

Rendition v2 (2026-09-04): the hand regripped around the holder, cable tube removed, windows opened. The solid hand becomes one that actually grips: four fingers and a thumb closing on the holder, teardrop windows opened through them, and the cable tube taken out entirely. 234.7 cm3, 202 g, 9 h 24 -- 70 g and two and a half hours off v1 for a part that does more. 5th percentile 1.93 mm, 2.9% thin.
